commits.patch:
diff --git a/libheif/color-conversion/alpha.cc b/libheif/color-conversion/alpha.cc
--- a/libheif/color-conversion/alpha.cc
+++ b/libheif/color-conversion/alpha.cc
@@ -134,12 +134,10 @@
                                                       const heif_color_conversion_options& options,
                                                       const heif_color_conversion_options_ext& options_ext) const
 {
-  // The colour planes and the alpha plane are all read through the single 'Pixel' type
-  // below, so every plane must be stored with sizeof(Pixel) bytes per sample. A file may
-  // declare a different depth per plane ('unci'); reading a one-byte plane as two-byte
-  // samples would run past its end (GHSA-r7gr-2xm2-23wf), and a plane wider than two
-  // bytes cannot be read through either instance. Decline anything else.
-  if (!input_state.all_channels_have_bytes_per_sample(static_cast<int>(sizeof(Pixel)))) {
+  // Match the colour plane storage to the Pixel type used by this operation.
+  // A file may declare different depths per plane ('unci'), so the colour
+  // samples must be checked before the operation is offered.
+  if (!input_state.color_channels_have_bytes_per_sample(static_cast<int>(sizeof(Pixel)))) {
     return {};
   }

coupling: The sample-width gate in 25783ac checks only colour planes, and the depth gate in 0f3778e accepts a different alpha depth. Either gate alone still excludes the 16-bit luma/8-bit alpha conversion. The later luma compositing path in 1487f16 drops the runtime alpha-depth comparison and reads that byte-sized alpha plane as uint16_t. All three edits are required for this public decode path; the fix must restore a shared colour/alpha storage invariant across planning and execution.
